question: Where can I find café positioned within 100 kilometers along the path to Kettle Creek Environmental Education Center, Stroudsburg, PA from VA New Jersey Health Care System - Lyons Campus, Lyons, NJ?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_Intersects( pois.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%VA New Jersey Health Care System - Lyons Campus%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Lyons%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Kettle Creek Environmental Education Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Stroudsburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 100000 )::geography );
